jobs.title: Director of College IT Support
jobs.description:
Department
: Office of the Dean Salary
: Commensurate with Experience/Education

Description

Internal Applicants Only

Directs the Information Technology Support unit that provides support services to a college in the areas of training, software and hardware; web services and centralized and technical support. Pursuant to the State of Texas Executive Order No. GA-48, this position researches, works on, or has access to critical infrastructure and requires the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the University infrastructure. This position requires personnel be routinely reviewed to determine whether or not criminal history or continuous connections for the government or political apparatus of a foreign adversary might prevent the employee from being able to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure.

Directs Information Technology support activities and operations in the areas of training, web information services, technical support, and documentation.
Collaborates with college faculty to implement information technology support services in support of scholarly and academic mission of the college.
Recommends and implements policies and best practices and assists in the creation and maintenance of college IT budget.
Promotes the incorporation of technology into teaching and research by providing demonstrations, training and maintenance of appropriate hardware and software.
Oversees the provision of computing services to students via labs, documentation, and tech support.
Coordinates training, support and documentation for technology applications used by staff in support of the college's mission.
Represents the college on committees, university-wide task forces, and national conferences.
Performs other job-related duties as required.

MQ: Requires application of advanced principles, techniques and theory in a professional discipline or a thorough general business management knowledge. Knowledge of this level is typically obtained through a directly job-related Master's degree or equivalent formal training in a recognized field of specialization that is directly related to the type of work being performed. Requires a minimum of five (5) years of directly job-related experience.

Department is willing to accept experience in lieu of education.

Additional Job Posting Information

Minimum 3 years of experience supporting healthcare or clinical IT operations, including clinical workstations, medical devices, HIPAA-regulated environments, or other healthcare technology services.

Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible experience in information security, IT risk management, compliance, vulnerability management, or security operations.
CISSP, CISM, CCSP, GSLC, CASP+, or equivalent advanced cybersecurity certification.
Experience administering Active Directory, Group Policy, MECM, Intune, Jamf Pro, Zendesk, Hyper-V.
Experience with vulnerability management, endpoint protection platforms, security monitoring, incident response, and regulatory compliance.
Experience developing and enforcing IT policies, standards, and procedures in environments subject to HIPAA, FERPA, and NIST security requirements.
Demonstrated success leading IT operations, endpoint management, user support services, and cybersecurity initiatives.

All positions at the University of Houston-System are security sensitive and will require a criminal history check.

The University of Houston System and its universities are Equal Opportunity Institutions. Everyone is encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Director of Business Operations & Technology
jobs.description:
Director of Business Operations & Technology

Location: Remote/Hybrid – Texas

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years

Education: Bachelor’s degree required

Key Responsibilities

Business Operations:
Manage critical SaaS systems, vendors, business applications, and day-to-day operational reliability. Identify inefficiencies and implement process improvements.
Hardware & Supply Chain:
Manage China-based factories and other manufacturing partners, including production, purchase orders, product costs, inspections, and operational issues.
Logistics & Fulfillment:
Coordinate domestic and international freight, customs, warehousing, inventory, and fulfillment across the U.S. and Europe. Manage warehouse, logistics, distributor, and reseller relationships.
E-Commerce & Business Systems
: Manage operational systems and integrations across Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, warehouse management systems, and other business applications.
Technology & AI:
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using technology and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok. Work with leadership and technical teams to improve systems, integrations, and workflows.
Growth & Execution:
Build scalable processes, solve cross-functional problems, lead operational projects from start to finish, and take ownership of new responsibilities as the company evolves.

Qualifications

● 10+ years of experience in business operations, technology, engineering, supply chain, e-commerce, or a related field.
● Bachelor’s degree required.
● Experience in a small business, startup, or entrepreneurial environment.
● Strong combination of business operations, technology, and execution.
● Application development background or strong technical understanding; comfortable with both software and hardware.
● Experience managing vendors and external business partners.
● Experience with international manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, warehousing, or e-commerce strongly preferred.
● Working knowledge of business systems, integrations, APIs, process automation, and AI tools.
● Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
● Self-directed and able to manage multiple priorities and drive projects through completion.

jobs.title: Director Technology Innovation
jobs.description:
Company Description
Mbatu Cooperative Credit Union Ltd (MBACCUL) is a Category 1 financial co-operative credit union owned and governed by its members. Established in 1968 and re-registered in 2001 as a microfinance institution affiliated with REÇU-CAM, the union focuses on inclusive financial services. MBACCUL receives and secures members’ savings, offers loans at competitive interest rates, and supports members’ investments and other financial needs. Its mission is to reduce poverty by serving as a financial partner for people across income levels. With seven branches in Cameroon and plans for further expansion, MBACCUL is strengthening its reach and impact through innovation and technology.
Role Description
The Director Technology Innovation is a full-time remote leadership role responsible for driving MBACCUL’s digital transformation and technology strategy. This role oversees the evaluation, selection, and implementation of innovative financial technologies that improve member services, operational efficiency, and data security. The director collaborates with executive leadership and branch teams to align IT initiatives with business goals, design digital products, and modernize core systems. Daily activities include leading technology roadmapping, managing key innovation projects, coordinating with vendors and partners, and monitoring emerging trends in microfinance and cooperative banking. The director also establishes governance frameworks, ensures regulatory and cybersecurity compliance, and mentors internal teams to build digital capabilities across the organization.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Research capabilities to evaluate technologies, assess risks, and support data-driven decision-making.
Candidates should possess Strategic Planning and IT Strategy skills to design and execute long-term digital roadmaps aligned with MBACCUL’s mission and growth objectives.
Candidates should possess solid Project Management skills to lead multi-phase technology initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver projects on time and within budget.
Candidates should possess knowledge of financial services, microfinance, or cooperative banking, with familiarity in digital banking platforms and cybersecurity best practices.
Candidates should possess proven leadership experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.
A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field is required; an advanced degree or relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, ITIL, Agile) are an advantage.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Description:

3 days in office/week,
2 days remote/week

Checking if interviews are in person or teams

local candidates preferred

Years of Relevant Experience:

·    8+ years project/programme management experience

·    8+ years’ experience with full lifecycle implementation projects from requirements definition through implementation

Preferred Education:

4-year college degree or equivalent technical study

Job Description:

The Program Manager directs, controls, and administers programs and projects within the organization. The Program Manager is the individual ultimately responsible for execution of assigned projects and management of the project team. The Program Manager’s primary responsibility is to drive initiatives from start to finish. The Program Manager must ensure that the program/project is completed on schedule and that the final product meets the business, technical, and established quality requirements. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

·    Manages the complete lifecycle of projects, including initiation, planning, execution, and closure.

·    Responsible for project compliance with established agency and project management standards and procedures.

·    Develop a detailed program/project plan, including identification of project needs and definition of tasks and milestones, all based on scope, budget, and resources.

·    Accountable for delivery of all work tasks identified in the program/project plan.

·    Responsible for the capture and reporting of required program/project management metrics.

·    Ensure all changes to scope follow established change procedures and are documented.

·    Accountable for management of scope for the program/project and gaining agreement and approval of scope changes with project sponsor and affected stakeholders.

·    Manage and track the program/project progress against the program/project plan.

·    Monitor project milestones and phases to ensure the project is on schedule. Take corrective actions if a project begins to slip its schedule.

·    Prepare and distribute status reports; schedule and monitor reviews as required.

·    Plan, organize, prioritize, and manage multiple work efforts across teams.

·    Responsible to tailor and baseline all program/project templates.

·    Notify team leads of project timelines, milestones, phases, work requests, and target dates.

·    Communicate effectively with all stakeholders, including team members, sponsors, vendors, and external partners, ensuring alignment on timelines, milestones, and objectives.

·    Analyze and distribute reports on program/project metrics associated with work items.

·    Accountable for the approval and sign-off of the program/project plan from project sponsor and all affected program/project stakeholders.

·    Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and project sponsor.

·    Serve as the primary point of contact for all program/project-related issues and resolution of issues.

·    Coordinate and present proposals to agencies as necessary.

·    Identify and manage program/project risk and develops risk mitigation strategies, track to closure.

·    Anticipate issues and proactively address them.

·    Develop and facilitate achievement of program/project service commitments and performance metrics.

·    Ensure that tasks provide value and support the strategic direction of the program/project and meet service commitments, conduct reviews with stakeholders.

·    Accountable for the final program/project management evaluation review with stakeholders for approval upon program/project completion.

·    Balance workload with program/project team members’ capacity.

·    Plan program/project specific training and orientation needs

Mandatory skills

·    Ability to effectively communicate with written and verbal communication to all levels of an organization, from front line staff to C-level executives.

·    Managing vendors and vendor-driven projects.

·    Managing technical/IT projects.

·    Proficiency in use of project management software

Certifications or Desired skills if any

·    Contract and/or vendor management

·    Cross-functional collaboration

·    Critical thinking

·    Problem solving

·    Priority setting

Nice To Have Skills

·    Change management

·    Business analysis

·    Conflict resolution

·    Government and/or Public Sector project experience

  Company Description
Hermez-IT is one of India’s fastest-growing IT recruitment companies, connecting skilled technology professionals with leading organizations worldwide. The company focuses on building long-term partnerships by understanding client needs and matching them with the right IT talent. Hermez-IT emphasizes innovation, responsiveness, and quality in its recruitment processes. Team members collaborate across regions and technologies, creating opportunities to work with diverse clients and projects. The organization values integrity, performance, and continuous learning in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.
Role Description
The IT Program Manager is a full-time hybrid role based in the Columbus, Ohio Metropolitan Area, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role is responsible for planning, leading, and coordinating multiple IT projects and initiatives to ensure they align with business objectives and are delivered on time and within budget. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining program scope, managing project timelines and budgets, coordinating cross-functional teams, and monitoring risks and issues. The IT Program Manager will collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, report on progress, and drive continuous improvements in processes and technology solutions. The role also involves ensuring adherence to governance standards, optimizing resource allocation, and supporting change management activities across the program portfolio.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Program Management and Project Management skills to lead complex, multi-phase IT initiatives.
Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret data, assess risks, and support data-driven decision-making.
Candidates should possess a robust foundation in Information Technology to understand systems, architectures, and technical dependencies.
Candidates should possess Budgeting and financial management skills to plan, track, and optimize program and project costs.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Agile/Scrum) are an advantage.
Proven experience managing large-scale IT programs or portfolios, preferably in a consulting, technology, or recruitment-driven environment.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to work in a hybrid environment, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing business needs.
